title: Senior Robotics Connectivity and Real-Time Systems Engineer
desc:
We are the catalyst for the industrial world’s digital transformation.
For more than 35 years, ground breaking technologies and business models engineered and developed by Siemens Turkey R&D department contributes to the global success of Siemens
Our R&D activities focused on the fields of electrification, automation and digitalization, provides end-to-end support to our global customers on their unique digital transformation journey.
We aim to increase our strength on solution and product development with world class SW development experts, with the vision to be the digitalization partner for our global customers.
We need game changers like you, to bring the next level of smart manufacturing and infrastructure from mere concept to reality, develop tomorrow’s smart cities, and address the most critical digitalization challenges across a comprehensive range of industries.
What are my responsibilities?
Develop and maintain production-grade robot connectivity and communication interfaces
Design and implement impedance control solutions for advanced robotic applications
Develop force-controlled and compliant robotic motion capabilities
Integrate standardized robot communication and interoperability interfaces, including SRCI-based solutions
Develop and integrate real-time control and motion execution interfaces
Design and implement future robot platform, runtime, and controller integration interfaces
What do I need to qualify for this job?
BSc., MSc., or PhD. in Mechatronics Engineering, Control and Automation Engineering, Computer Engineering/Science, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Proven track record with 5+ years of professional software development experience
Experience with industrial robot communication interfaces and interoperability standards, including UR RTDE, URScript, SRCI, OPC UA, and similar robot controller communication technologies
Experience in impedance and admittance control, force/torque sensing and calibration, compliance control strategies, and servo-level motion command streaming
Experience with industrial communication protocols and real-time systems, including PROFINET, IRT, OPC UA, cycle-time optimization, latency and jitter analysis, and motion control concepts
Strong experience with C++, Python, ROS 2 (including ros2_control and related drivers), protocol analysis, interoperability testing, and software integration
Experience in performance analysis, diagnostics, controller trace and log evaluation, latency measurement, system troubleshooting, and hardware-in-the-loop validation
Familiarity with industrial robot controllers and automation platforms such as Universal Robots, ABB, FANUC, KUKA, SIMATIC, SINUMERIK, or comparable technologies is an advantage
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams
Knowledge of and experience with Scrum and Agile development methodologies is an advantage
Very good command of English
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder communication skills
No restriction for travelling abroad
What We Offer?
Speaking up Culture
Respectful Workplace
Being part of a global work environment
Attractive remuneration package
Excellent recognition tools providing spot awards
Learning & Development opportunities for both personal and professional growth
Leave days for parents and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family

At Siemens we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse Digital Minds to develop tomorrow ‘s reality.
As Siemens we believe physical barriers are not related to potential. Only the potential matters to us. Therefore, we look forward to receiving applications from candidates with physical barriers and chronic illnesses.
